title: Governance Evidence Replay Discoverability Gap Map v1

replay_lookup_gaps.current_mechanism: ReceiptEnvelope.decision.governance_decision_id stores the GateDecision decision_id. Can find by reading all envelope files and checking decision field. No manifest index. No reverse lookup.
replay_lookup_gaps.missing_fields: governance_decision_id in manifest.jsonl; decision_id → envelope_id index
replay_lookup_gaps.missing_index_projection: in-memory dict or DuckDB table indexed on governance_decision_id
replay_lookup_gaps.recommended_fix: add governance_decision_id to manifest.jsonl as column 5; build in-memory dict {governance_decision_id: [envelope_ids]} on startup for < 10k envelopes; DuckDB projection for > 10k

replay_lookup_gaps.current_mechanism: FilesystemReceiptStore.get(envelope_id) reads sharded JSON file directly
list_by_session(session_id) scans manifest.jsonl line-by-line, filters on session_id, reads matching envelopes
replay_lookup_gaps.missing_index_projection: manifest scan is O(N); partitioned manifest or DuckDB projection would speed for > 1k sessions
replay_lookup_gaps.recommended_fix: DuckDB session_id index for > 1k sessions; current O(N) is acceptable for local mode
replay_lookup_gaps.phase: complete for current scale; P2 for scale

replay_lookup_gaps.current_mechanism: request_id is generated in MCP server/GovernanceRuntime for each call but is not stored in ReceiptEnvelope or ReceiptDecision. Node preserved in manifest.
replay_lookup_gaps.missing_fields: request_id in ReceiptDecision or ReceiptEnvelope decision; request_id in manifest.jsonl
replay_lookup_gaps.recommended_fix: add request_id to ReceiptDecision model; add to manifest.jsonl; propagate from MCP (already has request_id) and GovernanceRuntime (needs generation)

replay_lookup_gaps.current_mechanism: ReceiptEnvelope.decision.surface stores surface identifier. Can find by reading all envelope files. No manifest index.
replay_lookup_gaps.recommended_fix: add surface to manifest.jsonl; DuckDB projection: SELECT * FROM envelopes WHERE decision_surface = ?

replay_lookup_gaps.current_mechanism: ReceiptEnvelope.decision.authority_tier stores tier. Can find by reading all envelope files.
ReceiptEnvelope.decision.capability_id stores f'rig.{tool_name}'. ReceiptSubject.subject_id stores tool_name for MCP calls. Can find by reading all files.
replay_lookup_gaps.recommended_fix: add capability_id to manifest.jsonl; DuckDB projection for tool-specific queries

replay_lookup_gaps.current_mechanism: manifest.jsonl stores created_at ISO timestamp. Can scan manifest and filter. No range query support.
replay_lookup_gaps.missing_index_projection: binary search on manifest not supported (unordered append-only); DuckDB projection enables range queries
replay_lookup_gaps.recommended_fix: DuckDB created_at index for range queries; manifest remains append-only chronological

replay_lookup_gaps.current_mechanism: ReceiptEnvelope.decision.decision stores allowed/blocked/requires_review/not_applicable. Must read all files.
replay_lookup_gaps.recommended_fix: add decision_status to manifest.jsonl as column; DuckDB projection

replay_lookup_gaps.current_mechanism: no evidence_status field exists on ReceiptEnvelope or manifest. GovernanceDecisionEvidence.persisted() is runtime-only.
replay_lookup_gaps.missing_fields: evidence_status (persisted/failed/deferred) in ReceiptEnvelope or ReceiptDecision or manifest; runtime state not persisted
replay_lookup_gaps.recommended_fix: add evidence_persisted boolean to ReceiptDecision; propagate from GovernanceDecisionEvidence; record persistence_failed decisions with evidence_status=failed

replay_lookup_gaps.current_mechanism: neither artifact_refs nor source_of_truth_refs exist in ReceiptEnvelope or manifest
replay_lookup_gaps.missing_fields: artifact_refs, source_of_truth_refs in ReceiptEnvelope; manifest cannot index arrays
replay_lookup_gaps.missing_index_projection: DuckDB lateral join on artifact_refs array
replay_lookup_gaps.recommended_fix: add artifact_refs and source_of_truth_refs to ReceiptEnvelope; DuckDB lateral join for querying

common_envelope_gap_update.current_state_summary: ReceiptEnvelope covers: envelope_id, receipt_kind, actor.actor_id, subject.session_id, decision.governance_decision_id, decision.surface, decision.authority_tier, decision.capability_id, created_at. Missing: request_id (P0), mission_id (P2), input_hash (P1), output_hash (P1), payload_schema (P1), approval_receipt_id (on decision but not always set), policy_decision_id (aliased as governance_decision_id), trace_id (P1), artifact_refs (P2), redaction_scan_id (P2), source_of_truth_refs (P2), producer (P1), sequence (P2).

fields.mcp: present (in response dict, not in ReceiptEnvelope)
partial (stdio transport has trace_id; not in ReceiptEnvelope)
